messages:
hana: Heads-up: customer reported odd billing where a streaming session with a toolcall got both a provisional and a separate confirmed charge after a graceful reconnect. trace: sg-11a

omar: can you paste the minimal timeline?

hana: sure: router accepted -> provisional estimate 134 tokens; mid-stream reconnect -> router routed to fallback pod, header-mangler rewrote X-Idempotency; runtime retried toolcall -> confirmed 110 tokens; billing shows provisional+confirmed. snippet:```
[sg-11a] router: accept provisional=134 model=mu-xl
[sg-11a] router: route-change -> pod-fallback (rewrite-headers=true)
[sg-11a] runtime: toolcall retried, idempotency_header=null
[sg-11a] billing: ledger write provisional +134
[sg-11a] billing: ledger write confirmed +110 (no join)
```

devon: did routing intentionally rewrite headers? that seems wrong for idempotency keys.

hana: it was an old optimization to suppress certain client headers in internal hops; we thought idempotency was handled end-to-end but router->runtime mapping dropped it.

kevin: two failure modes: header loss + billing ledger semantics. currently provisional entries are materialized immediately on customer balance; confirmed entries are additive. we need deterministic replacement/dedupe rule.

omar: idea: generate stable session_commit_id at router ingress and include X-Session-Commit in all downstream calls. billing should upsert provisional using session_commit_id as key and replace when confirmed arrives.

devon: alternate: runtime generates a canonical runtime_request_id and emits it with provisional writes, but that won't survive reroutes. router is the right place to mint stable id. downside: router tied to billing contract.

kevin: ledger change: treat provisional as pending (separate bucket). On confirmed, move pending -> invoiced with final token count. If confirmed never comes within TTL, auto-expire pending and create adjustment. avoids heuristics.

hana: console UX: show "pending tokens" column beside invoiced, with tooltip "may be adjusted after finalization". admin can open manual dispute for large items.

ui-team: agree; also need alerting tile "pending-to-final delta" and ability to filter by model, route, and org.

omar: telemetry: emit billing.pending.created(session_commit_id, estimate_tokens, model_hint), billing.pending.finalized(session_commit_id, confirmed_tokens), billing.pending.expired(session_commit_id). Add session_commit_id to traces so we can join router+runtime+billing.

devon: short-term mitigations: 1) revert the header-mangling rule in canary, 2) add runtime guard to reject toolcall replay without client idempotency header unless session_commit present, 3) instrument router to log session_commit for recent sessions.
\eledger-bot: note: flagged 1 open incident for customer acme-inc; provisional=134 confirmed=110 delta=24 tokens.

kevin: owners: billing#601 (pending-ledger-migration) -> @kevin, router#299 (session-commit header) -> @devon, console#412 (pending-ui) -> @ui-team, telemetry#88 (events) -> @omar.

hana: QA scenarios to add: late-confirmation (confirmed arrives after TTL), model-swap reducing tokens, toolcall that returns no token usage (0), and truncated stream with early EOF. add harness cases and e2e asserts on ledger state.

omar: one nuance: quotas. provisional must still count toward short-term quota gating, otherwise customer could exceed quota before confirm. plan: provisional reserves quota on accept; confirmed finalizes consumption and decrements pending reservation. sync with quota team.

hana: agreed. I'll write the design PR for billing semantics and a small canary to ship router header propagation after revert. ping when PRs ready. :thumbsup:
